title: Navigation, repeat dealer visits, and access drawbacks
summary: This topic combines concrete complaints about poor navigation and repeated dealer returns with many brief downside mentions about access, seating, and system usability that lack enough context for firmer sentiment classification.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor navigation performance and having to return to the dealer again for the same problem after only a short time.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention downsides such as hard entry and exit, seat sizing, and hard-to-use system controls, but several fragments are too brief to determine clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short downside phrases without enough surrounding context to classify the specific issue confidently.
This cluster mixes several subjects, including navigation, dealer return visits, cabin access, seating, and infotainment usability, so it is not a single coherent issue.
Examples are limited, so the sample does not support broader conclusions beyond the cited fragments.
